annotations.title: Withdraw the go-ahead on this car

description: Ends the buyer's go-ahead on this car, and the visit with it if there is one. Use it only when the buyer says to. cancel_visit is different: it ends only the visit and keeps the go-ahead. Going ahead with another car is a separate step. If the dealership already had the go-ahead, it is told the buyer is not going ahead (`told: true`). With `told: false`, the dealership never had it, so it is not told. The first change from an assistant that is not ChatGPT or Claude may need the buyer to tap a confirm link Ridekick emails.

id.description: The id of the request, from requests_list. For an entry of kind `single`, this is the entry's `id` from requests_list.

rowKey.description: The row key of the one dealership, from requests_get. An entry of kind `single` in requests_list has no rows: its rowKey is that entry's `id`, the same value as `id`.
